messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Seek emergency medical attention or call the Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222. An overdose of cyclobenzaprine can be fatal, and deliberate overdoses often involve other drugs or alcohol, which raises the danger. 1,2
Overdose symptoms may include severe drowsiness, fast heartbeats, tremors, agitation, slurred speech, confusion, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, or hallucinations. Rare but critical effects include seizures, dangerously low blood pressure, heart rhythm disturbances, and cardiac arrest. 1,2
Triplet: ["Cyclobenzaprine", "has rare critical effect", "seizures"]

The relation 'has rare critical effect' in the triplet is defined as 'An overdose of the subject drug may lead to the rare but severe medical complication or condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has overdose risk': An overdose of the subject drug may result in the serious or life-threatening consequence specified by the object entity.
B. 'has overdose symptom': An overdose of the subject drug may cause the symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
D. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
E. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
